signal: Lyric raised a $43.5M Series B led by Insight Partners with revenue up 500% as Fortune 500 supply-chain teams adopt its AI decision platform

email.body1:
Deb, saw Lyric raised the $43.5M Series B with Insight and grew revenue 500% as Fortune 500 supply-chain teams adopt the platform.

Growth that fast usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Lyric off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Deb, quick follow-up for Lyric.

After a raise plus 500% growth, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Lyric needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Deb, last bit of proof for Lyric.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lyric's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B enterprise AI teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Deb, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while you ride this growth, no problem at all. The stretch right after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise supply-chain motion? I'll tailor it to Lyric either way.
